'''Luufkin''' was a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] fence originating from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]. During the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], he worked with [[Quip Fargil]] to secretly undermine the Empire.<ref name="mf">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
